about: Retrieval eval for the SkillFlow Assistant (scripts/assistant-eval.ts). expect lists the source keys that answer the question; any one in the top 5 counts. mode is what the assistant should do for a learner who has passed nothing yet: answer, hint (an un-passed explain-back idea), or not-sure (nothing relevant). A stage key also matches the resources in that stage.
